title: QBit Vault identity
brief: Visual identity for QBit Vault, a secrets broker for coding agents under the QBit personal brand: mark, wordmark, palette, type, README banner and the terminal header the TUI will use.

artboards.title: Redacted
artboards.tradeoff: Tells the product's story in one image (the redaction bar) and works well in a terminal; cool and technical, less warm. Intended typefaces: Inter Display / JetBrains Mono.

artboards.title: Dial
artboards.tradeoff: Instantly reads as a safe and feels physical and trustworthy; a more familiar security metaphor, and the brass needs care to stay legible. Intended typefaces: Söhne / Berkeley Mono.

artboards.title: Ket
artboards.tradeoff: Ties straight into the QBit brand (|q⟩) and is the most distinctive; the quantum idea needs a line of explanation and the math glyphs depend on the system font. Intended typefaces: Satoshi / IBM Plex Math / Commit Mono.
